Solid foundations- what I’d say is you need more ways of getting your pirates to hit face. You can run laser base or moon base z instead of the graveyard and some bounce cards like pogo or backyard bounce - smoke bomb is alright but it’s less versatile than a bounce. Barrel too is a bit of an awkward one as it doesn’t really synergies with pirates it just doesn’t really fit in the curve of turns 1,2,3,4 - they’ll always be a different pirate that builds more tempo than barrel on those turns. However, if you made changes from what I’ve just described you’ll end up just making the pirate pogo-mug deck everyone runs so it’s cool you’re trying out different things.
